name: popover
purpose: Anchored, **non-modal** overlay that opens from a consumer-supplied trigger and renders rich, interactive content — a header (title + optional description + close), a free-form body, and a footer for actions — in a floating panel anchored to the trigger. Use for inline forms, filter builders, and contextual detail or confirmation that needs interactive children. Unlike `tooltip` (plain text, non-interactive) and `dialog` (modal, centered, focus-trapped), the popover leaves the page interactive, anchors to its trigger, and closes on `Esc` or outside-click. It differs from `dropdown-menu`, which renders a menu of selectable options rather than free-form content.
useWhen: Use Popover for rich or interactive content (a form, actions) opened by a click and closed on purpose; a one-line hint is a Tooltip and a read-only hover preview is a HoverCard.
Interactive content anchored to a trigger while the page stays usable: an inline form, a filter builder, a quick edit of one field.
Contextual detail or a light confirmation that needs buttons or links inside it.
avoidWhen: A short, non-interactive hint on hover or focus → use `tooltip`.
A list of actions or options to pick from → use `dropdown-menu`.
Choosing a form value from a list → use `select`.
A blocking task that must be completed or cancelled first → use `dialog`.
A long form or a secondary workflow → use `drawer`.
related: `tooltip` — plain text only and non-interactive; opens on hover and focus, not on click.
`dropdown-menu` — same trigger and anchoring model, but renders option rows and emits `select`.
`dialog` — modal and centered, traps focus and locks scroll; the popover does neither.
`drawer` — edge-anchored modal panel for longer content.
bestPractices: Place `Popover.Trigger` first and `Popover.Content` after it. The trigger wires `aria-expanded`, `aria-controls` and the click toggle onto your element, so don't bind them yourself.

Let `Popover.Trigger` show the pointer: its wrapper sets `cursor-pointer` (`cursor-not-allowed` when disabled), so a `Tag`, `Avatar` or icon slotted in reads as clickable. Don't put `cursor-pointer` on the slotted Azion UI component — `azion-ui/no-style-override` blocks it.
Include a `Popover.Title`. The panel takes its accessible name from it through `aria-labelledby`.
Set `size` for forms and filter builders so the panel doesn't resize as content changes. Without it, the panel sizes fluidly between the `--container-3xs` and `--container-xs` tokens.
Use `side="auto"` for triggers that can sit near a viewport edge.

Use `side="end"` (or `"start"`) for a trigger in a narrow column or a sidebar, where the panel should open beside the trigger instead of covering the content below it. `start` and `end` follow the text direction, so the panel opens on the inline end in both `ltr` and `rtl`. Type a side held in a variable with the exported `PopoverSide` (and `PopoverAlign` for the alignment), never a cast.
Bind the open state with `v-model:open` (or `:open` + `@update:open`, whose handler receives a `boolean`).
Set `dismissible` to `false` only when an outside click would discard input. Then give the user a way out: `Popover.Close` or a footer action.

props.name: side
props.doc: Side of the trigger the panel opens on, flipped when it does not fit; `'auto'` picks the side with the most room at open time.

props.name: sideOffset
props.doc: Pixel gap between the trigger and the panel.

props.name: disabled
props.doc: Prevents the trigger from opening the panel and applies disabled tokens.

props.name: size
props.doc: Panel width preset mapped to container tokens: `'small'` (`var(--container-xs)`), `'medium'` (`var(--container-sm)`), `'large'` (`var(--container-md)`). When omitted, the panel sizes fluidly between `var(--container-3xs)` and `var(--container-xs)`. Same name as the size preset of `Dialog`, `Drawer` and `ConfirmDialog`.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.doc: Initial open state when uncontrolled (`v-model:open` unbound).

props.name: dismissible
props.doc: Light-dismiss: when `true`, the panel closes on outside-click and `Esc`. Set `false` to keep it open until the trigger or `PopoverClose` closes it.
